about: Grandchild of recipe-core through meal-planner (third generation). Money and pack-rounding are new; units and float noise are inherited themes.

tasks.title: Stop float errors in prices
tasks.prompt: Ten cartons of milk total 11.899999999999999. Fix money handling throughout and add tests.
expect: money is integer cents (or Decimal), never float dollars

tasks.title: Buy enough, not nearest
tasks.prompt: Needing 300 g rice orders one 250 g pack: round() rounds down. We must always buy at least what's needed. Fix, and also handle the list being in a different unit than the pack.
expect: pack counts round up (ceil) after converting to the pack's unit

tasks.title: Pick the cheapest pack mix
tasks.prompt: For 3 l of milk, 1x2l + 1x1l is cheaper than 3x1l. Pick the cheapest combination of packs that covers the need.
expect: choose the cheapest pack combination covering the need (small knapsack over pack sizes)

tasks.title: Substitute out-of-stock items
tasks.prompt: When an item is out of stock, suggest a substitution (e.g. 2 l milk for 2x1 l) instead of silently dropping it. Missing items must never vanish from the order.
expect: never silently drop an item; report substitutions and misses
